summary: Verified the access-tracking bug fix on BRK painel (home-page access now registers automatically on load with device/OS/location). Backend: 8/8 pytest passed (login, acesso mobile iOS, acesso desktop Windows, activities acesso_home, acesso_faturas regression via /public/lead, faturas list, auth guard). Geolocation via ip-api.com works (8.8.8.8 -> 'Ashburn, Virginia, United States'). Frontend: admin login OK; clicking KPI card 'CLICKS PAGINA HOME' opens clicks-modal listing each access with location, device (Celular/Computador), SO, browser, datetime and IP. Public page /minhabrk.html fires on-load POST /api/public/acesso exactly once per session (sessionStorage guard brk_acesso_ping=1) and the home counter incremented 6->7 end-to-end. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: parse_browser order places Chrome before Safari which is correct, but iOS Safari sometimes reports as 'Outro' (first iPhone row showed navegador='Outro') because the iPhone UA used in tests lacked a matching 'Version/.. Safari' token ordering; cosmetic only, device/so/location unaffected.

geolocate() does a synchronous external HTTP call (ip-api.com) wrapped in asyncio.to_thread with 3s timeout on every /public/acesso; acceptable but adds latency to the public ping and depends on a third-party free API (rate-limited ~45 req/min). Consider caching by IP.
minhabrk.html uses relative var API='/api' (works only because iframe is served from frontend origin and ingress proxies /api); brittle if hosted elsewhere - noted in prior iterations too.
test_credentials: admin username 'donas', password from backend env ADMIN_PASSWORD. test_credentials.md is empty - creds live in /app/backend/.env (ADMIN_USERNAME/ADMIN_PASSWORD).
seed_data_creation: Tests posted several public /api/public/acesso pings (expected public behavior, cidade prefixed TEST_) and one /api/public/lead with documento 12345678901. These are public-endpoint records; no data was deleted or modified. Public clicks cannot be deleted via API by design.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 8 requested behaviors PASS. Backend env vars for pytest must be exported manually: export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env|cut -d= -f2) and ADMIN_USERNAME/ADMIN_PASSWORD from backend/.env, then run pytest. Login UI: input[placeholder='Digite seu usuario'] + input[type=password] + button 'Entrar'; wait for [data-testid=dashboard-page]. KPI card testid=kpi-clicks-pagina-home opens [data-testid=clicks-modal] with rows [data-testid=click-row-N]. minhabrk.html on-load ping fires once per session (sessionStorage brk_acesso_ping); the browser_automation tool's own initial navigation consumes the ping, so an in-script re-goto won't re-fire - verify by comparing /dashboard/clicks total before/after.
rca of the issue: Original bug: home-page access was never registered because POST /api/public/acesso only fired on CPF submit (Continuar). Fix verified: minhabrk.html now has an on-load pingAcesso() that POSTs /api/public/acesso once per session; backend enriches the record with device (parse_device), so (parse_os), location (geolocate via ip-api.com using X-Forwarded-For) and created_at, and writes an acesso_home activity. Confirmed end-to-end: fresh page load incremented clicks_home total 6->7 and the Dashboard modal displays location/device/SO/datetime.
